name: knob
title: Knob for a shaft
summary: Push on knob for the shaft of a real part in the catalog (a potentiometer, a rotary encoder), built from the maker's published shaft size: a press fit bore held by four flexing fingers, a flat for a D shaft, and an index groove.

params.name: product
params.help: the exact part the knob goes on, from the catalog (stone show reads it from the request)

params.name: material
params.help: PLA is stiffer, so a small press holds better

params.name: press
params.help: how much smaller the bore is than the shaft, per side
